models.baseline: GFN1 xTB engine partial charges and shell descriptors with the published RegioSQM feature recipe; CM5 is not claimed unless an explicit CM5 transform is added
models.candidate: regularized logistic regression and gradient-boosted trees
models.evaluation: nested training split for hyperparameters; untouched scaffold test set
models.preprocessing: fit scaling, feature selection and train-median imputation inside training folds; retain missing indicators

tuning.fold_source: manifest cv_fold, restricted to primary train partition

feature_groups: Mulliken/Löwdin density populations and p-to-s ratios
pi population and pi bond order
local Fukui, local softness and local electrophilicity

acceptance.primary: at least one primary metric difference over GFN1 has a molecule-bootstrap 95% CI entirely above zero, with no significant deterioration in the other primary metrics
acceptance.negative_result: report no stable incremental benefit when the primary condition is not met
acceptance.minimum_reporting: all failures, missing descriptors, method/temperature sensitivity, per-atom coverage, calibration and runtime
